h: Mr Eazi says he has never paid Shatta Wale, yet the Ghanaian star always turns up at his shows
p: Mr Eazi has reportedly spoken about his friendship with Shatta Wale, saying the dancehall star shows up at his concerts without being paid.
more: The two Afrobeats and dancehall stars have long supported each other's shows.
